stories.title: U.S. and Iran exchange fire despite ceasefire. And, Trump nominates a new head of ICE
stories.description: The U.S. and Iran exchanged strikes over the weekend, putting their latest ceasefire in jeopardy. And, Trump has nominated a former Oklahoma state trooper to head Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

stories.title: Trump says the U.S. and Iran will meet in Qatar after weekend attacks
stories.description: President Trump said talks with Iran would resume Tuesday in Qatar, despite the two sides trading attacks in the Gulf over the weekend. Iran did not confirm whether it will participate.

stories.title: Former Iran nuclear deal negotiator on what U.S.-Iran 'new normal' looks like
stories.description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former national security adviser and 2015 Iran deal negotiator Jake Sullivan about ceasefire talks amid new strikes by the U.S. and Iran.

stories.title: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes, underscoring the fragility of the ceasefire
stories.description: President Trump accused Iran of violating their framework agreement, and Tehran threatened to halt negotiations with the U.S. entirely. Meanwhile, violence continued between Israel and Hezbollah.

stories.title: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran
stories.description: A series of strikes over the weekend saw the US and Iran accuse each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

stories.title: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
stories.description: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.

stories.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon as Hezbollah condemns new deal
stories.description: Strikes have killed at least one person, state media say a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement.

stories.title: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
stories.description: Iran accuses the US of violating their deal and says it struck targets linked to American forces in response.

stories.title: Israel and Lebanon sign framework agreement after US-brokered talks
stories.description: Hezbollah is not party to Friday's agreement, and previous ceasefires between Israel and Lebanon have still seen near-daily cross-border strikes.

stories.title: Trump accuses Iran of ceasefire breach after Strait of Hormuz attack
stories.description: A Singapore-flagged ship was struck crossing the waterway on Thursday, prompting a large-scale evacuation to be paused.

stories.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
stories.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

stories.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
stories.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

stories.title: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
stories.description: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.

stories.title: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

stories.title: Trump says Iran requested Doha meeting as Tehran denies direct US talks
stories.description: US President Donald Trump said on Monday Iran had requested a meeting in Doha on Tuesday, despite Tehran denying direct negotiations with Washington. stories.title: Strait of Hormuz: 'Iran has made it very clear that there are new rules', analyst says
stories.description: Iran said Monday it had held its first meeting with Oman on managing the Strait of Hormuz since it signed a preliminary deal to end the Middle East war with the United States. stories.title: Israel-Lebanon deal may entrench stalemate rather than end war, analysts say
stories.description: A security deal between Israel and Lebanon risks entrenching a stalemate rather than resolving Tel Aviv’s underlying conflict with Hezbollah by tying its pullout from southern Lebanon to the group’s disarmament, a condition regional analysts and politicians say is unattainable. stories.title: Turkiye must be 'included' in Europe security structures: Erdogan ahead of Nato summit
stories.description: Turkiye must be included in all of Europe’s defence and security structures, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said on Monday, a week ahead of a key Nato summit in Ankara. stories.title: Iran and US agree to halt attacks and renew talks, US official says
stories.description: Iran and the United States agreed to halt recent hostilities in the Gulf and renew talks regarding their dispute over the Strait of Hormuz, a US official said on Sunday, raising hopes of saving an interim peace deal that was under pressure from days of tit-for-tat strikes. stories.title: FO summons Afghan envoy, issues 'strong' demarche over terrorist attack on Karachi Rangers camp
stories.description: Foreign Office (FO) spokesperson Tahir Andrabi said on Monday that the Afghan chargé d’affaires was summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Mofa) and issued a strong demarche over the terrorist attack on a Rangers facility in Karachi. stories.description: • US hits Iranian targets after tankers come under fire• IRGC hits US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain in retaliation• Negotiators expected to meet in Doha this week to discuss Hormuz control• Araghchi asserts sovereignty over vital waterway; seeks collective security framework for Gulf ...

stories.title: West Asia war LIVE: Trump says meeting with Iran this week 'perhaps' important
stories.description: Iran says 'expert delegation' heading to Doha this week; no negotiation talks with U.S. in the coming days

stories.title: Trump says U.S.-Iran meeting to take place in Qatar as Tehran denies any sit-down in coming days
stories.description: U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump's adviser and son-in-law Jared Kushner "will be flying to Doha for high-level meetings this week", White House said

stories.title: Bihar Governor Hasnain and Minister of State Margherita likely to represent India at Khamenei’s funeral
stories.description: Commentators describe the funeral in Tehran as a “big opportunity” for India to restructure its West Asia policy; they say the choice of the delegation indicate that India has not recognised the importance of the event

stories.title: Senior Lebanese official slams U.S.-brokered deal with Israel, warns of divisions
stories.description: The Lebanon war has been a central part of diplomacy towards ending the wider U.S.-Iran conflict

stories.title: Iran’s President says $6 billion in frozen assets in Qatar to be released as U.S. talks challenged
stories.description: Masoud Pezeshkian’s mention of the funds appear aimed at selling the Iranian public on the interim deal

stories.title: U.S., Iran pause strikes but disagree over next steps on talks
stories.description: The U.S. President has tried to preserve an increasingly fragile interim deal as hostilities have mounted in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days

stories.title: Upcoming US-Iranian consultations may be important — Trump
stories.description: The US leader made it clear that the consultations will, among other things, touch upon the question of the Iranian nuclear program

stories.title: Number of ships crossing Strait of Hormuz on decline for third consecutive day
stories.description: In all, a total of 108 ships crossed the Strait of Hormuz between June 26 and 28
